content.title: The Heat and Hornets are playing tonight, and most fans have no idea where to watch-here’s how
content.text: Miami Heat center Bam Adebayo, center, and teammates huddle up ahead of free throws during the second half of an NBA basketball game against the Atlanta Hawks, Sunday, April 12, 2026, in Miami. (AP Photo/Rebecca Blackwell)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLiveToday’s NBA slate features the Miami Heat taking on the Charlotte Hornets in this exciting NBA Eastern Conference Play-In. The tip is scheduled at 4:30 p.m. PT/7:30 p.m. ET (5:30 p.m. MST) on Tuesday, April 14, and the only way to watch is streaming on Amazon Prime.What TV channel is the Heat vs. Hornets NBA play-in game on today, or is it streaming only?When: 4:30 p.m. PT/7:30 p.m. ET (5:30 p.m. MST) on Tuesday, April 14Where: Spectrum Center in Charlotte, North CarolinaWhat TV channel is the game on? Amazon Prime Video is not a TV channel, and there is no TV broadcast for this game. This game is only available to watch live streaming on Amazon Prime.How to watch the game streaming live: You have to sign up for Amazon Prime ($14.99/month or $139.00/year) to watch this game live on your TV, computer, phone, or tablet with the Prime app. To sign up, follow the instructions on Amazon Prime, and it will walk you through the process.
